exposure: Cytokine levels (IL-1β, IL-2, IL-6, IL-17A, IL-18, IL-22, IL-10, IFN-γ)
finding: S100A12 protein was found to be a significant biomarker for neonatal sepsis, even after adjusting for confounding factors.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was included as a confounding factor in the analysis but specific findings related to mode of delivery are not reported.
